scope: 2968-record benchmark only; historical 400-record test excluded from splitting and tuning
coordinate_convention: zero-based, end-exclusive; every record requires a matching UCSC reference receipt
sequence_rule: unit-cost global Levenshtein distance on 200-base sequences, minimum of forward and reverse-complement distance
components: Transitive closure of all genomic-proximity and sequence-similarity edges; groups cannot be split
stratification: Greedy group assignment balancing strong, weak, and non-enhancer counts; SHA-256 seeded tie breaks
limitations: Project evaluation policy, not the paper's leave-one-out design or its CD-HIT filtering procedure.
The 1000-base gap and 40-edit cutoff are predeclared safeguards, not proven biological independence thresholds.
Global edit similarity does not detect every short shared motif or distant homologous segment.
Nearby groups may remain correlated beyond 1000 bases. Chromosome-held-out evaluation can be a later sensitivity check.
